actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared original, complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Compact yellow mascot head and broad short neck fit the proportionately widened collar, without clipping, a long yellow neck or white belly at neckline. Original dark frame, internal backing and overlapping aged lower-right card remain; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole alpha spans 0..255; finite interior samples support near-opaque backing, head, clothing and paper, with no material holes visible in the composites. Art qualification only. This source is archive-only under the Chinese CCP release exclusion policy and must remain absent from final mod payload; its art state is not a publication blocker. No live-game acceptance claimed.
